messages:
tara: Kicking off micro-canary for release v0.6.2 — target start 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Need deploy owner + smoke owner + rollback lead. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~100m. Cohorts: beta-users + geo:eu.

mike: I'm happy to be deploy owner. I'll be on-call during the window and will trigger traffic shifts.

jen: I'll own smoke and rollback. I'll run the smoke checklist and have the rollback playbook ready. ping me 10m before start.

luca: I'll watch tracing + logs (grafana alerting on errors/latency). I can set a 5m slack alert for error rate spikes.

alice: Quick question on cohort selection — are we doing header-based routing or weighted LB? If header, confirm header key: `x-canary-group`.

tara: header-based routing using `x-canary-group`. We'll seed cohorts via signup flag for beta-users and geo header for eu. Weighted LB used only for the percentage increments on the global bucket.

mike: Rollout config I'll use (will paste before start):
```
canary_config:
  increments:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 10m
    - pct: 5
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 20
      duration: 60m
  cohorts: ["beta-users", "geo-eu"]
  fallback: previous-stable
```

jen: CR reminder: PR #4521 needs an approval for the small routing change. @eng-platform please take a look — it's gating the canary header code.

luca: Adding alerts we'll watch: `service.errors.p90 > 1%` and `inference.latency.p95 > 1200ms`. I'll attach board link in 5.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout v0.6.2 for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z (UTC). Assigned: mike (deploy owner), jen (smoke/rollback).

tara: Preflight checklist for deploy owners (short):
- PRs merged + CI green (jen)
- Canaries mapped to cohort flags (alice)
- Grafana + tracing dashboards open (luca)
- Rollback playbook tested (jen)
- Post-mortem owner assigned if anything goes sideways (tara)

mike: All good on my side. I'll do a dry run at 21:30 UTC to validate routing and metrics ingestion.

alice: Cohort flags: will flip beta-users flag to `staging` for a 100-user seeding at 21:45 UTC, then scale up once 1% stable.

jen: Smoke checklist (short):
1) sanity calls to /health and /v1/generate (sample prompt)
2) check error rate + logs for NPEs
3) verify KV cache warm-up not regressing
4) confirm model accuracy sanity prompt returns expected intent
I'll post results in thread when done.

luca: Board link: https://grafana.example/redwood/canary-v062 (watch p95, errors and token cost).

mike: On the call: I'll post a `starting` message when I bump to 1%, then update after each stage. If jen says `rollback` I will cut traffic and promote `previous-stable`.

jen: Affirmative. If errors > 1% sustained for 3 consecutive 5m windows or latency p95 > 2x baseline, I'll call `rollback`.

tara: last quick ask — post the final percent + timestamp updates in the thread (we use this thread as audit). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

mike: ack. See you at 21:30 dry run.

jen: will check PR #4521 now.

alice: seeding done at 21:45 in staging flag.

deploy-bot: deploy event: v0.6.2 -> canary started (1%). Event ts=1765001260

mike: bumped to 1% at 22:00 UTC. initial smoke passes, no errors.

luca: telemetry OK so far, errors 0.2%, p95 610ms.

mike: bumping to 5% at 22:12 UTC.

luca: after 5% bump: errors 0.9% (still below threshold), p95 720ms. continuing to monitor.

jen: smoke pass after 5% bump. KV warm-up looks fine.

mike: bumping to 20% at 22:55 UTC per plan.

luca: at 20% now: errors 1.4% — crossing threshold. diving into traces.

jen: I see a latency regression correlated with a model variant in eu cohort. calling rollback.

mike: executing rollback to previous-stable now. I'll update when complete.

deploy-bot: rollback executed by mike. traffic restored to previous-stable. Event ts=1765001286

luca: post-rollback metrics: errors back to 0.3%, p95 640ms.

jen: filing follow-up ticket for model-variant QA and cohort isolation: TICKET-789. tagging research and infra.

tara: great run — good coordination. we'll rerun after variant fix; target next attempt Tue 22:00 UTC. I'll update release calendar. :white_check_mark:
